summary: Increase the bounded local-owner provider quote window from 10 to 20 seconds for post-biometric Topnet revalidation.
reason: Two real pre-dispatch attempts exceeded the 10-second core quote bound even though normal Topnet reads complete around 3-5 seconds. The second case had 46 seconds of owner-confirmation validity remaining, proving the failure was the quote bound rather than late owner approval.

tests.name: runtime-build
tests.evidence: TypeScript build passed after configuring the explicit 20-second quote bound.

tests.name: payment-core
tests.evidence: Payment Core regression includes the explicit quote-window invariant and all payment tests pass.

capabilities.reason: The payment capability contract is unchanged; only a bounded runtime timeout is corrected.

architecture.reason: No new component, retry path or store; the existing core timeout is adjusted.

rollback: Revert this scoped commit to restore the 10-second quote bound.
limitations: A provider read that exceeds 20 seconds still fails closed before financial dispatch.
